context: Dosage & Administration Directions Shake well before each use. Adults & Children 12 years of age and older: Take 2 teaspoons (tsp) (10ml) 1/2 hour before bedtime. Dose may be repeated if necessary. Children under 12 years of age: Consult a doctor
